title: Oxindole Compounds Induce NRF2-ARE Antioxidant Pathway in MCF7 Cells and Reduce Inflammatory Response in RAW264.7 Cells.
authors: Selvaraj, Baskar; Nguyen, Qui Ngoc Sang; Ko, Seong-Hee; Yoo, Ki-Yeon; Kang, Suk Woo; Lee, Jae Wook
one_liner_zh: 该文研究吲哚酮类化合物激活NRF2-ARE通路及抗炎作用，虽涉及KEAP1蛋白与配体共价对接，但核心是化合物药理学而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或MD模拟方法，仅量子化学与对接，与TF-DNA课题关联微弱。
abstract: Using previously reported chemical structures and synthetic methods, we prepared a series of 19 oxindole derivatives and evaluated their ability to activate the NRF2-ARE signaling pathway and induce the expression of downstream antioxidant genes. All 19 compounds activated NRF2-ARE signaling. Among them, OIC3 and OIC15 were selected for further investigation based on their relatively low EC(50) values of 6.20 and 4.95 microM, respectively, as well as their favorable cytotoxicity profiles. Both compounds activated NRF2 in a concentration-dependent manner and progressively increased the expression of the NRF2 target genes HO-1 and NQO1 over 8-24 h. Their anti-inflammatory activities were further evaluated in RAW 264.7 macrophages. Quantum chemical calculations identified the exocyclic benzylidene carbon as the most probable electrophilic reaction site, while covalent docking suggested that the Cys151 adducts of both compounds could be structurally accommodated within the KEAP1 BTB domain. Collectively, these findings identify OIC3 and OIC15 as promising NRF2-ARE activators and support their further investigation as potential therapeutic candidates for oxidative stress- and inflammation-related diseases.
abstract_zh: 利用先前报道的化学结构和合成方法，我们制备了一系列19种oxindole衍生物，并评估了它们激活NRF2-ARE信号通路及诱导下游抗氧化基因表达的能力。所有19种化合物均能激活NRF2-ARE信号。其中，基于相对较低的EC(50)值（分别为6.20和4.95微摩尔）以及良好的细胞毒性特征，选择了OIC3和OIC15进行进一步研究。这两种化合物均以浓度依赖性方式激活NRF2，并在8-24小时内逐渐增加NRF2靶基因HO-1和NQO1的表达。其抗炎活性在RAW 264.7巨噬细胞中进一步评估。量子化学计算确定外环亚苄基碳为最可能的亲电反应位点，而共价对接表明，两种化合物的Cys151加合物在结构上可被容纳于KEAP1 BTB结构域内。综合来看，这些发现将OIC3和OIC15确定为有前景的NRF2-ARE激活剂，并支持将其作为氧化应激和炎症相关疾病的潜在治疗候选物进行进一步研究。
